paragraphs: According to Euronews, Mexican special forces captured drug kingpin Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “Chapo Isidro”, during a raid in Sinaloa, with footage showing soldiers escorting him into an army vehicle. Al Jazeera reported that he was on the FBI’s most wanted list and faces US drug charges.

DW reported that the alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang was captured by the Mexican military following a raid and a shootout in the coastal Sinaloa state. Fox News noted that the arrest sparked gunfire, burning vehicles, and panic among civilians.

title: EU Council President Proposes Smaller Budget and Digital Services Tax
summary: António Costa has proposed a reduced EU budget for 2028-2034 alongside a new digital services levy to break financial deadlocks.
paragraphs: According to DW, European Council President Antonio Costa proposed a smaller EU budget for 2028-2034, including a 3% tax on major digital firms to ease member states' contributions, though France has already rejected the plan as inadequate. Euronews reported that Costa proposed cutting the budget by nearly €200bn, representing a 10% reduction, to win over frugal countries.

Euronews further detailed that cohesion funding was cut for the first time under the proposal, and a 3% digital services levy would replace a controversial corporate tax while slowing down debt repayment.
